name: PQM → Quivver Transition — v3 (Kick Aligned)
description: v3: Kick phase alignment. Quivver shifted -2006 samples to align kicks at overlap bar 40. This aligns kicks but introduces ~38ms broadband content offset — the fundamental trade-off of mixing different producers. A DJ aligns kicks by ear; the timbral difference masks the broader content offset.
